purpose: Portability execution of the new optional-tail and capture-touch specimens on a separate GitHub-hosted Linux platform; no repetition of accepted performance campaigns.
compiler: G++13.3.0, ld2.42; abort on version drift; retain executable hashes and actual platform/library versions
touch_overlay: Exactly the registered unused-this-capture removal in a generated copy; all original native files remain unchanged.
execution_order: Build optional normal8/normal16/sanitized8/sanitized16 and touch normal/sanitized, seal all six; then optional cases in that build order, ascending 512/1024/2048 and absent/unread/clustered/dispersed; finally touch serial1/phased1/phased4 for normal then sanitized.
memory_scope: No per-process RSS acceptance claim in this Linux profile; small fixed fixtures and the GitHub-hosted job envelope apply. Array metrics are from the fixture, not process RSS.
failure_rules: Stop on any build/runtime/diagnostic, version, identity, coverage or projection mismatch. Retain complete attempted output. No rerun or selective retry under this registration; a source repair requires a new version and fresh full collection.
not_qualified: all existing carrier arms on Linux/Windows/Wasm
linker_resolution: Accept an absolute GCC-reported linker path, or resolve a bare program name through PATH; refuse other relative paths. Record the resolved BFD linker hash and force its search directory.
library_versions: Retain dpkg-query versions for libc6, libstdc++6, libgcc-s1, g++-13 and binutils, plus resolved libstdc++/libgcc/libc shared-library hashes.
trigger: Source-sensitive push on the dedicated research branch; later documentation-only pushes do not recollect the registered cases.

supersedes.disposition: collector setup failure before all builds/cases
supersedes.reason: GCC returned bare ld; Path.resolve incorrectly treated it as relative to the source checkout. No compile or candidate process ran.
